what: Failure modes §1 promises an `.inc.bash` positional harness case and names case 2 as earliest signal for `.inc.bash` pre-commit skips, but the UPDATED test section adds only three positional cases (good.sh, bad-unsuppressed.sh, notes.md) and none invoke `.inc.bash` positionally
scenario_or_breakage: Existing `inc.bash extension is scanned` uses `--root` only; a positional-branch bug that accepts `.sh` but rejects or mishandles `.inc.bash` would not fail proposed cases 1–3. Case 3 only exercises the linter’s in-script `\.(sh|inc\.bash)$` skip for `.md`; it does not detect a wrong pre-commit `files:` regex that never passes `.inc.bash` to the hook
suggested_fix: Align the plan: either add one positional violation case reusing the `helper-bad.inc.bash` fixture pattern from :139–144, or revise Failure modes §1 and the “earliest signal” sentence to state that `.inc.bash` positional coverage is manual-only (Testing strategy :103) and that case 2 targets `.sh` argv handling only
